1.consolidated_definition: vulg. Aprisa. (Anticuado en España. “Como Rodrigo esto oyó, apriesa pide el caballo.” . Para Ac. no es vulgarismo).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Hurry up. (Archaic in Spain. "As soon as Rodrigo heard this, he hastily asks for the horse." For Ac., it is not a colloquialism.)
